title: Partnership Overview
summary: Operating model, governance cadence, and partnership structure for sustained delivery.
narrative: The partnership model translates the delivery architecture and modernization roadmap into explicit governance, staffing, and execution rhythms to ensure sustained value realization.

Execution is anchored by a tiered governance structure, including a weekly Transformation Design Authority and a monthly Architecture Review Board, ensuring alignment between modernization waves and operational stability.

The delivery model leverages a global footprint across three strategic centers to balance cost-efficiency with business-facing agility, transitioning toward a target delivery mix of 35% onshore, 10% nearshore, and 55% offshore by year 3.

cards.title: Governance Cadence
cards.detail: Weekly design authority, monthly architecture review board

callouts: Holiday code freeze applies from mid-November through early January for customer-facing platforms.
Target delivery-mix shift to 55% offshore is achieved by year 3, with architecture and product ownership remaining onshore-led.
Architecture review board meets monthly and transformation design authority meets weekly during active modernization waves.
Wave 1 prioritizes customer identity, pricing, returns, and observability foundations before major order and supply-chain rewrites.
Platform engineering capacity is shared across commerce, loyalty, and supply-chain programs, so sequencing must avoid parallel peak demand.
